text: Stop for a moment!

This is the #:King's Library:#.
Without the king's permission, I won't let you pass.
zh:
这里是#:国王的图书馆:#。
没有国王的许可，我不会放你过去。

text: I have the permission to enter.
Why don't you make an exception?
Step aside or you'll get a beating.
I'll come back later.

This is the #:King's Library:#.
Without the king's permission, I won't let you pass.
zh:
这里是#:国王的图书馆:#。
没有国王的许可，我不会放你过去。

text:
Really?
Usually, I'll get notified when someone is allowed to visit the library.
zh:
是吗？
照理说，有人获准进图书馆时，我会收到通知。

text: You may pass.
Baron Frestek wants you to get this.
zh: 弗雷斯泰克男爵要我把这个交给你。

text: Nevermind then.
I see.
You may pass.
If the king found out that I let anyone in here, I could start writing my will.
zh: 要是让国王发现我随便放人进去，我就可以开始写遗嘱了。

text: No exceptions!
What?
You want to attack a member of the royal guard inside the king's castle?
zh: 你想在国王的城堡里袭击皇家卫队的人？

text:
Here?
Where most of us guards are?
zh:
就在这儿？
在我们大部分卫兵都驻守的地方？

text: That was a stupid idea.
Indeed.
